scorecard.venue: Dr. Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b B Kumar

batting.name: SS Iyer
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b P Kumar

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b A Ashish Reddy

batting.name: RS Bopara
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b JP Duminy

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b Imran Tahir

batting.name: KV Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b NM Coulter-Nile

balls.text: saw the batsman moving to play a lap sweep, but Bhuvi was alive to the matter. Bowled a wide yorker, but the one-upping wasn't done yet. Jadhav adjusts spectacularly well and brings down the open face in contact with the ball and finds a great boundary to third man
full on the base of middle stump, Mathews can only tonk it back to long-on. Just a single again
walks at the fuller delivery and turns the yorker into a low full toss, swiped away to deep midwicket
fuller delivery on middle and leg, whipped away to wide long-on
another great yorker on middle, Jadhav moves outside leg and chops it away to point
nails the leg-stump yorker and Mathews works it away to deep midwicket. Wants two, but Jadhav says no
phew! That hit the bat with a resounding crunch! Full toss from Praveen, yorker gone horribly wrong and Jadhav has nailed it over the deep midwicket boundary
finds the blockhole on middle, nudged to long-on who rushes in to keep it to a single
that's the slower ball and Mathews has picked it, runs down the track to turn it into a half-volley and launches it straight down the ground. Legcutter gone wrong
makes a little room outside off and lashes a very full delivery down to long-off. Great execution of those fuller balls from the Sunrisers
looks for the yorker a shade outside off, worked away to deep midwicket
runs down the track, but yorks himself. Manages to direct the ball to deep midwicket for a single
finishes with a pin point yorker on off stump, can only get a single after digging it out on the off side
runs down at the slower short ball, has to adjust with a pull stroke that almost carried to Ashish Reddy at square leg. He was diving forward to make something of it, but it bounced just before him
finds the yorker on off stump, slid to point. Mathews was sent back by his nonstriker and he barely makes his ground. Goodwork from Rahul again, but a direct hit could have had him!
full on off stump, squirted out to Bopara again at deep midwicket
back of a length on middle and off, Mathews works it towards square leg for a quick single
fuller delivery outside off, driven smartly to long-off
slower ball, a touch short and Jadhav has pulled it to deep square leg
shortish and outside off, sliced to point
back of a length and outside off, tapped towards long-on
shortish and a shade outside off, Jadhav was looking to guide it past the keeper's gloves but doesn't succeed

what. a. catch! Warner has done it again! This was a long hop that was sailing beyond the midwicket boundary, but Warner waits for it. He times his jump with insane precision and thrusts his hands over head and grabs a stunner with the boundary inches from his feet as he comes down! Boy, is he pumped!

leg and middle stumps are in disarray as Steyn removes his country-mate to finish his spell! Duminy was looking to be a little too cute with a lap sweep, all he did was direct the ball onto his stumps
fuller delivery outside off, pushed through the covers

banged in short and Yuvi has managed to time his pull quite well. There is protection in the deep though, probably Morgan. Sussed up the ball wasn't getting up as much and decided to play it after all
looks for the blockhole on off stump, clipped to backward square leg on the boundary
doesn't matter at which pace it comes down at for Duminy! He races at the back of a length ball and tonks it over long-on. Skimmer of a six. Strike rate is 136 now

shortish and outside off, eased towards point for a single. But there's a direct hit at the bowler's end. Yuvi though seems home. It's KL Rahul with the dead-eye throw but Yuvi drags his bat in well in time
fuller ball on leg this time is sent into orbit over long-on! Looks like Duminy's taken a look at his strike rate and does not like it at all
bisects the men at deep midwicket and long-on! Lands the slower ball wrong and Duminy has pulled it with supreme power
offcutter on a fuller length on off stunmp, defended
keeper up now and the shortish delivery wanders down leg. Duminy was looking to pull and the ball lodges in the keeper's gloves. Appeal, but there was no bat. Only thigh pad
races down the ground and bullet drives a slower ball down the ground! Right thorugh Bopara's legs and before he even realised. Talk about power!
offers a short ball outside off and Yuvi flat-bats it to long-on

he is hurrying everyone! 145 kph! This is why there were calls for his return. Shortish delivery cramping Duminy for room as well and as he was looking to flick, he gets the inside edge and lobs off his body. Nearly carried to an on-rushing Steyn

makes him slip off his feet as Steyn raps Yuvraj on the pads. Skids in at the batsman as he was looking to flick, struck in line with the stumps, but the ball had pitched outside leg. Drops his bat but completes the single
shortish and outside off, Duminy slaps it to deep point
a shortish delivery, but this doesn't rise too much. Yuvi is slow on the pull and is struck on the glove as the ball deflects to long leg
he is luring life out of this pitch! That was taken by the keeper well over his head! Loads of pace, loads of carry, cuts across the left-hander off back of a length and leaves Yuvi a little bemused
good length ball a shade outside off, Yuvi is in line with it
that was at his normal pace, and it was short. Duminy pounced all over it with a pull to the deep midwicket boundary
slow, full and down leg. Duminy goes for a sweep but can't reach
well directed slower ball a shade outside off, Duminy looks to slide it towards point for a single but there isn't one there
full and on the pads, Yuvi whips it to deep square leg
fuller delivery on off stump, pushed into the off side for Warner to cut across from short cover
slower short ball outside off, it's no longer a surprise for Duminy as he pulls to deep midwicket
shortish on off stump, punched back down the ground

dropped  by a diving short midwicket. It was a fuller ball on off stump, Yuvi was forward with a flick and the ball was moving on its way to the right of the fielder. Bopara, I think was the man, who threw himself full length at the ball. But this time he wasn't able to grab hold
full on middle and leg as Praveen goes around, clipped to deep midwicket and a resounding roar around Vizag as Yuvi gets to the batting end
pulls all the pace off it and Duminy can't succeed in nurdling it into the gap at fine leg

done him in! He seemed to be tiring to me. Fooled by the slower ball that holds on the pitch. Was into his slog way too early and the leading edge settles into Warner's hands at cover. Canny bowling from PK and Sunrisers again
leaps way outside leg, telegraphed his intentions and Praveen nods and bowls a slow, fuller ball just inside the wide tram lines. Way out of reach
slower ball on leg stump, Duminy gets down the track to whip to deep square leg

shortish on leg stump, he was looking for a clip through midwicket but was into the shot too early. Went in the air, but there was no one around to threaten it's progress. Ashish has to run after it himself
good length on off stump, sent packing to deep midwicket
pummeled! Overpitched deliveries at that pace aren't any problem whatsoever. Launches the ball beyond the long-off boundary

didn've have enough power to reach the fielder at deep midwicket. Morgan was the man running in after Shreyas mistimes his slog - hit it with one hand as he meets the ball way too early. Morgan dives forward, but it bounces just short of his reach
that's the leg cutter gone way wrong. Goes too short, wanders down leg and Shreyas should kick himself for missing the pull
shortish and outside off, Shreyas guides it to point
pulls the pace off, but slides it down leg. Duminy works it towards backward square leg
flighted outside off, driven down the ground
flat, quick and pushed wider outside off. Shreyas isn't quick enough to cut it away
Steyn is interested at long-on again, but this is a flat and brutal strike from Shreyas to bring up his maiden IPL fifty. It was rather full again, but those strong wrists provide enough power
gets under a pretty full delivery on off middle stump and shovels it from there to the long-on boundary. Got on one knee and scythes the ball away
good length ball on leg stump, another single found in the deep midwicket region
gets down the track to a flatter delivery on leg and works it to deep midwicket
long-on was back so Shreyas has no problem with chipping a length ball down the ground
shortish and slower and outside off, Duminy goes back and short-arm pulls it to deep midwicket
slants a fuller ball way down leg. At less than 120 kph, he should have better accuracy
another slower ball, fuller on middle. Shreyas clips it towards deep midwicket
fullish on off stump, Shreyas pushes it back at the bowler
slower delivery on middle and leg, Duminy waits for it and knocks it to midiwcket for a quick single
stays around the wicket and the angle it affords helps Duminy, especially with fine leg up. Duminy stays back and clips it nice and fine
looped up on off stump, whipped down to long-on. Doesn't come off the middle
moves outside leg to lace a flatter, fuller delivery over the off side field. Not as well timed this time and long-off is on hand to stop it

runs at the bowler, reaches the pitch and wallops him into the sightscreen to bring up the Daredevils fifty! Brilliant footwork form Shreyas, didn't give the bowler any indication of his intentions until it was too late
tossed up on middle, Duminy looks assured with the clip to deep midwicket and Bopara keeps it to just a single
tossed up on middle, pushed to long-on. Held the ball back pretty well there. Asking the batsman to make his own pace
tossed up on off stump, Duminy uses the closed face to clip it to long-on
shortish with enough width for that cut shot, but it bounces over Shreyas' bat and causes a groan from the batsman as well. That's the time out
stays around the wicket to Duminy and lobs it full on middle and leg, clipped to long-on
third slowy on the trot and Shreyas sends it to deep midwicket
fuller delivery, lacks pace again. Came off the back of the hand, nudged to deep midwicket

slower ball, lovely change of pace from Bopara, as Duminy looks to bring his bat down to block. Gets an inside edge into vacant infield on leg. Races for a couple and the deep fielders are too late to respond. Warner is not pleased

looks to slice the ball behind point, can't succeed it. Morgan tries to catch the striker out of his ground, but the man backing up inside the 30-yard circle fails to back up and Dhawan behind him misfields as well! Comedy of the year
finds the blockhole and it's pushed down to Steyn, who had been pushed back to long-on after that six
back of a length on middle, Shreyas was making room to open up the off side, but he doesn't have enough. Tapped back to the bowler
length ball, picked up and muscled over long-on! Nothing comical about that as he leans on his front foot and hammers it away
beautiful slower ball form Praveen! Beats the advancing Shryeas all ends up and makes him look like a spinning top as he tries to slog
shortish and outside off, slid towards point

that's a skier! Steyn chases after it towards the straight boundary. But it appears to have been in vain. He caught up with it, was flicking the ball back into play when it touched the advertising triangles. Shreyas was fooled by the ball holding in the deck and hitting him high on the bat as he wanted to loft through the line
back of a length, slips down leg again, he's been having a little bit of radar trouble today. Shakes his head as he walks back to his mark
curls in on middle and leg, looking for the yorker perhaps, but it ends up a low full toss that is clipped to the right of mid-on
banged in short and Shreyas veers away from the line of the ball. That was at 136 kph, pretty quick for Bhuvi
seeks to play across the line of a good length ball on middle and leg again, wanders off the pads towards the off side for a quick single. Good, alert work from Shreyas

tries to manufacture something a bit too much against a back of a length delivery on middle and leg. Looks to pick it up and deposit it into the deep square leg boundary. Wears it high on the pads, and the cross-seamer pitched outside leg as well
back of a length on off stump, blocked back at the bowler
fuller delivery, angled across the left-hander to keep the lone slip in play, Duminy wants to push down the ground but doesn't time it.
good length ball on off stump, eased between point and cover
shortish on off stump, kept out

edged, but it was well wide of the first slip! Healthy edge, would have been gobbled up by second slip! Duminy had played that last dot with hard hands, so Steyn gambles by bowling another fuller delivery to entice the drive. Hard hands again, but it benefits Duminy
good length ball outside off, Duminy is forward with a defensive bat
full on off stump, but this back-foot punch goes right off the toes of the bat. Pushed to the right of cover for a single. Bounce is up and down again
good length ball seeking the middle of middle, Shreyas does not oblige

seemed to stop on the pitch which was why JP appeared to be a little too early into the drive. The length ball goes in the air past the bowler's right and Warner at mid-off dives across to his left to stop it
good length ball on off stump, blocked solidly
fullish on middle and leg, clipped rather smartly to deep square leg. Hints of inswing there
shortish and slipping down leg. JP moves outside off to flick it off his hips and misses
no bounce again! This was pitching closer on the stumps and JP shuffles in line and brings down his bat just in time

huge appeal! JP had jumped right across to try and sneak a single behind square leg. Kept seriously low and hit him adjacent with middle, that's why Bhuvi was instant with his appeal. But it pitched outside leg
there we go! Lovely line just outside off and Agarwal was tempted by third man a bit too much. Flashed the angled blade and presents slip-catching practice to Dhawan
shortish on off stump, knocked into the covers for another quick single and some overthrows as well
back of a length on the fifth-sixth stump, guided off the open face off the back foot square of third man where the fielder fumbles and allows two. Great work from the batsmen. Bopara, was it?
pierces the cover field as he steps forward to a length ball and caresses it through the gap. The only issue with that was the width given the free the arms and Shreyas accepts the treat
140kph, pushes him back with a pacy, shortish delivery on off stump. Shryas softens his hands and blocks towards point
shortish and curling away again, but this time Shreyas has watched it far better and leaves
Shreyas pokes at a fuller delivery, he's on the walk as it swings away and the outside edge falls short of the second slip fielder. Looks like KL Rahul

back of a length on off stump, Agarwal waits on it and defends with the open face to try and beat the lone slip fielder now. But Praveen doesn't offer much pace and Dhawan has an easy stop diving to his right
good length on middle and leg, nudged to deep midwicket
more and pronounced inswing this time, enough to beat Shreyas playing that leg glance again, and it goes for a wide
slipping towards leg is this fuller delivery and Shreyas presses his front leg across and clips it to the long leg boundary
a shade short and wide again, Agarwal slaps to point

walks at the medium-pacer, gives up his strategy too early and is met with a shorter delivery that moves away off the deck. Wafts at it with the open face and is beaten. Appeal from the keeper, followed suit by the bowler. No response from the umpire
searches for swing with a fuller length, finds a little cut back in at the batsman, but it is tagged with enough width for the batsman to lash to deep third man

caught at long-off! That's all over! Only six off the over and Daredevils have held together in the crunch! Karn was clearing that front leg again and Coulter-Nile bowls it full and wide to try and evade his reach. Splices it off the bottom of the bat and Mathews was easily under it

who is that?! Mayank may have saved the match here! This was carrying beyond the point boundary. Coulter Nile has given the ball every batsman in this situation wants - length - and it's sliced with great authority square on the off side. Mayank tracked it well, went back to the edge of the rope, leapt up and then slapped the ball back into the field of play
looks to make room, but Coulter-Nile is wise to that ploy. Bowls a fuller ball a little wider of off stump. Knocked into the covers for a single. This is an amazing over so far
full and a shade outside off, slapped down to long-off and Mathews keeps it to one

wide yorker, with the batsman making room. Great option from Coulter-Nile and the batsmen wanting to sneak a bye hurts them? Or was it because Karn wanted the strike for his big swing over midwicket? Perhaps. Reddy is late to respond and is beaten by the throw from the keeper back to the bowler, and then Coulter-Nile racing back to knock the stumps over
backs away to a full delivery on middle and leg and slices it! Has he beaten short third man? No, straight at him. Only a single
they've got two! Great running, and a bit of luck as Mathews took a bit of pace off the belt down the ground and inadvertently gave his fielders a little more ground to cover

length ball, smashed! Sunrisers are in this yet! Slower ball, picked up and he gets reward for staying put, keeping his balance and drawing his leverage from it. Amazing strike, definitely pleased the dugout
and cue the slower ball. Offcutter gets Reddy charging, but his slog mags him lose his shape. Beaten all ends up and it was about a whisker away from off stump too
manages to land it pretty full on off stump, but Reddy has camped so far deep in his crease that he has been able to shovel it up and over mid-off. Top strike!
and its the slow, short wide delivery that's slapped to the sweeper
slower ball - the offcutter - beats the rank slog from Karn Sharma. Clears the front leg looking for the midwicket boundary. No luck
fired in quick on a length on leg stump, heaved to deep square leg
another one! It's the sweep again and Karn has revived the Vizag crowd! Lays into a full toss like a starving man at a banquet paid for by someone else
heaved over the wide long-on boundary, that's the advantage of a left-hander against a legspinner, he can take the length ball and convert it. Seemed the googly too
spears in on the base of leg stump and Reddy can only push it down to long-on
full toss on leg stump, worked away to deep midwicket
hits the blockhole on middle, Reddy digs it out to long-on

away goes the off stump. Morgan was making room, and went overboard with it. Duminy fires in the quicker one and roars in delight as he beats the batsman all ends up. A little check on the no-ball and all's fine for Daredevils
around the wicket, with a bit of a round-armed action. Pushes the good length ball outside off, which in turn is pushed to long-off
picks out long-off! Easily done by Manoj Tiwary. It was overpitched, but was wide. Had to reach out for it and that ruins his timing. Bopara went through with the stroke and pays for it
good length ball on off stump, Morgan pushes into the covers and runs. Shreyas had one stump to aim at and could have had him short had it struck target
seeks the yorker on leg stump with a very round-armed action, Bopara tries to flick but doesn't time it. Slips past the keeper
tonked over long-off! Possibly the biggest one of the match as he sizes up the width on this overpitched delivery and launches it high and handsome

JP's taken a super catch diving forward! Ojha waits after shovelling the wide, tossed up through the off side. But the fielder swooped in from point, threw himself forward and to his right and takes a lovely grab. Third umpire confirms and off he goes.
flighted on off stump, thumped to long-on
tossed up and dipping on leg stump, Ojha goes for the slog and it takes the inside edge to Coulter-Nile at deep square leg. Can't risk a fast bowler's arm
shortish and spinning away from the bat, Bopara was looking to slap it down to mid-off. Doesn't time it
gets under the tossed up delivery outside off and lofts it over long-off. Just about. The bat face wobbled big time on impact, but it still had enough
gets down the track, while making sure he was besides the good length ball, driven through the covers
slower, good length ball on off stump. Ojha was into the loft a bit too early and was adjusting his shot even as he was playing it. Luckily for him mid-on was back
ducks.... under a Mathews bouncer! That's a little too much respect as the short ball goes over off stump
smoked! Vicious hit from Ojha as he stands and flat-bats a length delivery one-bounce into the cover boundary. Who needs feet movement in T20?!
fuller delivery cramping him for room, but Ojha is able to whip it away over midwicket for a couple of runs before the deep fielder from square leg can catch up
full on middle, driven to long-on for another single
good length ball on leg stump, worked to long-on
fuller delivery on middle and leg, Bopara steps out and makes room while doing so, drilled into the covers
Agarwal's misjudged this at long-on! Rushed in thinking the belt from Bopara wouldn't reach him, but then realises it does have enough power. Has to backpeddle, and ends up parrying it over the ropes

tries it again, but this one doesn't rise as much as he hopes. That's what the batsman has to contend with on a slow, two-paced pitch. Not easy to trust your big shots, and that's what's needed for a run-rate over 11
bowls short and Bopara has picked it up terrifically early and hammers it to the deep midwicket boundary. Sublime hit
fuller delivery outside off, pushed into the covers
shortish and outside off, slid to deep third man
length ball outside off, with a hint of curve away from the bat.  Waft and miss
shortish and outside off, sliced to deep third man
knocked him over now! Moves too far across to make use of the gap at long leg, but he can't make contact with the length ball on leg stump. He misses, Mathews hits

dropped by Muthuswami. It was a swirler at mid-off. He was the only one closest and never looked like taking it. The way he had to dive at the very last minute to his right showed how nervously he had tracked the ball. The required rate has told on Rahul He as ran at the medium-pacer who is canny enough to bowl another slower ball and make the pitch work for him
back of a length on off stump, tucked to short midwicket
slower ball to start off, Rahul pushes it down the ground for a single
inside edge, but the the stumps are safe much to Tahir's agony! Made the batsman play across the line and beats the sweep shot with the way he pulled the ball back. Excellent leg spin bowling
fullish and flat on leg stump, Rahul taps it down towards long-on
shortish and outside off, cracked to deep point
a shade short and Rahul jumps back for a pull. Mistimes it to long-on
slower through the air and lured Rahul into playing away from the body. The slice almost carries to short third man
stump to stump line and Boara steps down to push down the ground
back-foot punch through the covers - read misfield - allows him to retain strike. Fielder had to move to his right, but wasn't quick enough with the dive
some turn for Mishra, who has to dive across to his right to keep a clip from Bopara from passing through
goes back again to work the fuller delivery on middle and off to deep midwicket
this time he has dealt with the short ball and how! Moves back and across, excellent use of the crease to pummel the pull over the wide long-on boundary
tosses the leggie up on the stumps, Bopara lands his front leg across and tucks it through square leg
gets down to a length ball on off stump, taps to long-on where Angelo Mathews is
advances to clip a flighted delivery off middle to deep midwicket
fuller deliveyr on off stump, driven past a diving Yuvraj. Has to be said that he was a bit slow moving to his righ tthere
nips down again and nudges the good length ball through to wide long-on
down the track and wallops Yuvraj beyond the long-off boundary. Claps from Warner and the Sunrisers flags are in full force. Good footwork to get to the pitch and gain leverage
pulls the ball back on off stump, Rahul steps forward to block
loopy one to start and its outside off as well, smeared to deep point
flighted delivery outside off, drilled through the covers
long hop, pulled to long-on. Should have done better than that. Required rate nearing double-digits
carrom balls, are they? Fuller delivery on off stump, holds its line and it's defended
pushed through on middle and leg, almost seam-up, I think. Worked towards midwicket
flighted on off stump, defended
a shade short and outside off, Rahul goes deep in his crease and punches to long-on
flighted on middle and off, kept out
flighted on middle, turns into the right-hander again, tucked away through midwicket
skids on does the googly and Rahul who had jumped back to make his room is almost bowled. Just about manages to get his bat down in time
through him! Good length ball, dips and turns a shade away. Rahul plays down the wrong line as he searches for the ball. Hands leading into the shot, beaten and only just misses the stumps
sliding on leg, Bopara is bale to tuck it to long-on since it was overpitched
flighted on middle, defended
tossed up outside off, Bopara reaches to the pitch and runs it through point
goes back to a shortish delivery and punches it down to long-on
good length ball on off stump, defended

double-wicket over! "Come on," yells Duminy after Warner's fall (Irony, thanks for stopping by) This was a tossed up delivery from around the stumps. Tailing in on off, which might have been what tempted Warner to seek midwicket with the closed face. Plays too early and takes the leading edge back to Duminy who takes a good, low catch diving to his right
flighted delivery on middle and leg, nudged past midwicket

off stump takes a hit! Was expecting turn, possibly trying to slide it down to third man for a single, but Duminy never turns the ball. He simply slides it on with the arm and exploits the gap between bat and pad when the batsmen expect the ball to deviate away. Hands raised in a simple smile after the fact

mid-off can't get there! Sunrisers have their fifty as the powerplay ends. That's the time out as well. It was a length ball on off stump, but his lack of pace is hurting him.  Warner simply backed away and hacked it down the ground
full and on the pads, Warner has worked it to deep square leg for a couple
picks the gap at extra again, this one with a simpler extension of defence! Sunriers have woken up now. Six fours in the last two overs
fetch that! Down the track to make a length ball into a half-volley and smears it through extra cover. Blistering power

only one stump left standing.... at the bowler's end! Just a shade shortish on middle and Warner unleashes a vicious forehand. Stopped a boundary, or if you look at it the other way, Dhawan could have been run out had the bowler got his fingers on it
clears mid-off comfortably! Calculated risk from Warner against the slower pace of Muthuswami. Presses forward and lifts the back of a length ball down the ground. Good percentage cricket
fuller delivery on off stump, defended with soft hands. Dhawan wanted the single, but Warner says no
exposed all his stumps, risky but reaps the rewards with a slice through point! Took it off the stumps and has timed it extremely well. He's very good at the square region
back of a length on middle and leg, tucked to short midwicket
moves outside leg to give himself some room, and he finds the boundary..... through the keeper's legs! Thick inside edge as he tries to cut a ball a bit fuller than he expects and gets away with it
back of a length on off stump, pushed into the covers
first boundary of the innings and it's a peach! A shortish delivery only a shade outside off, Dhawan lets it come on and opes the face so very late to find the third man boundary
fuller delivery on off stump, slapped to long-on. Looked to hit it with a little too much power there
fuller delivery on leg stump, clipped to deep square leg

wears another one, on the stomach this time, and manages to get across to the other end before he gets down on his haunches. Has a smile on his face though. Short ball came on a little too quickly than he thought and his pull is useless
112kph, skips down the track to a fuller ball outside off and crunches it to cover. Shreays was the man
fuller delivery on off stump, presses forward to defend
width outside off, but Dhawan is unable to make the most of it. Lead feet doesn't allow him to time the cut shot. Bottom edge to the keeper
short on off stump, Warner stays put on leg stump and rides it to the left of deep third man for a couple. Good running
shortish on off stump, Dhawan stays beside it and runs it down to deep third man
cleanly struck along the ground to cover. Fuller delivery, this one keeping the slips in play since Dhawan can be susceptible to edge behind. Good captaincy
shortish on leg stump, Warner plays a controlled pull to square leg
no room to Warner it appears, as this fuller ball is on leg stump and is whipped through midwicket
back of a length on off stump, tapped into the off side for a quick single
Another fumble, this time at cover from Shreyas who raises a hand in apology. Single easily taken in the end
short and wide outside off, Warner slaps it to mid-off and Mishra misfields. Poor work
veers too far down leg, worried that Warner would make room again
comes on with the arm despite the slower pace, Warner moves outside leg to cut. Finds cover
good length on off stump, Dhawan goes back and punches to long-on
waits on the flighted delivery on leg stump and nudges it to square leg
stays low again and Warner can't put bat to this good length ball outside off. Jadhav, the part-time keeper, gets up too early but he couldn't be blamed for this.
creamed through the covers! When it's fuller Dhawan is serene to watch, presses forward and hits the gap quite easily

struck on the ribs and Dhawan is winded! 142 kph delivery, short and was on him before he could even bat an eye lid. He was trying to leave it outside leg, perhaps misjudged the line, then tried to defend, but was in no position. Physio comes out, but it appears he's okay

full on off stump, Warner keeps still at the crease but finds his timing with a push through cover. The ring is quite tight on the off side and it comes up trumps this time, Mayank has saved three runs. Warner and Coulter-Nile share a smile
shortish and cramping him up on leg stump, Warner has to jump up to try and flick and wears it on the thigh
